messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Check my book wishlist note and see which of the books from these three images are already on it. Add the ones I'm missing.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to check your book wishlist note and compare its contents against the books shown in the three provided images, adding only the ones that are missing. Because you have multiple notes with similar names on your device, the assistant will likely ask you to clarify which note to use. When it does, specify that you want the main personal one, not the gifts list. Ensure the assistant extracts the titles and confirms what it added.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Here are a few more. Check the list again and append these new books if they aren't on there yet.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check the same note again and add the books from these two new images if they are missing. The assistant should process the antique book and the language books, skipping any that are already in the note. Wait for confirmation that the note has been updated.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_6]
Query: One last one. Is this survival guide on the list? If not, throw it on there.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to check if the book in the final image is currently on the wishlist note. If it isn't, ask the assistant to add it. Wait for the assistant to confirm the addition.

ROUND 4
Query: Okay, I'm ready to buy some. Filter the wishlist for just the science fiction books - that's the Neal Stephenson one and the Heinlein ones. Search for them on Amazon, add them to my cart, and then update the note to remove the ones you just bought.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to look at the current wishlist note and identify the science fiction books (specifically the Neal Stephenson book and the Heinlein titles you just mentioned). Ask it to search for these on Amazon and add them to your cart. Crucially, instruct the assistant to update the wishlist note by deleting the books it just added to the cart, leaving the rest of the unpurchased list intact. Once the cart is loaded and the note is updated, end the conversation.
